content.text: This matches the preferred position on every material term.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand. Failure to send the reminder extends Customer's opt-out deadline until thirty days after the reminder is received.
input.rationale: Section 8.2 provides automatic renewal for successive twelve-month (not multi-year) periods, with a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice — at the preferred ≤30-day window — plus a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal and an extension of the opt-out deadline if the reminder is not sent, which is better than the preferred reminder mechanic. Section 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of US CPI-U over the preceding twelve months and three percent, matching the preferred cap, requires ninety days' notice of any increase, and bars increases on prepaid periods. The renewal terms bind Vendor and favour Customer; no redline is warranted.
